title: Property Preservation Desk Note: Base Runway Length in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases After a Borrower Death
content:
**Rule.** When a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case on a Cedarline Summit loan is reclassified to the Death of Last Surviving Borrower plan, the base runway length used for the successor runway is set by the most recent occupancy inspection finding on the borrower's occupancy profile. The profile is held under Occupancy and Residency Certification.

- **Occupied by someone other than a borrower:** where the most recent finding is that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower, the base runway length is 60 calendar days.
- **Vacant:** where the most recent finding is that the home is vacant, the base runway length is 20 calendar days.
- **Any other finding, or none:** any other finding, or no inspection finding at all, leaves the base runway length at 30 calendar days.

**Which finding is "most recent".** The finding with the latest inspection result date on the occupancy profile is the most recent. Where two occupancy inspection findings carry the same most recent date, a finding that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower prevails over a finding that it is vacant, and a vacant finding prevails over any other finding.

## Finding to base runway length

| Most recent inspection finding | Base runway length |
|---|---|
| occupied by someone other than a borrower | 60 calendar days |
| vacant | 20 calendar days |
| any other finding | 30 calendar days |
| no inspection finding on the profile | 30 calendar days |

## Hypothetical profiles

- An earlier inspection found the home vacant, and a later inspection found it occupied by someone other than a borrower. The later finding governs: 60 calendar days.
- Two inspection results carry the same latest date, one vacant and one occupied by someone other than a borrower. The occupied finding prevails: 60 calendar days.
- Two results carry the same latest date, one vacant and one of another kind. The vacant finding prevails: 20 calendar days.
